theorem Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.source_then_physical_operator_trace_limits.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1}
  [inst : MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module ℂ V] (mu : Measure X)
  (b : X → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
      (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (rho : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hm : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (rho n))
      (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : X), 0 ≤ rho n x ∧ rho n x ≤ 1),
      (∀ (x : X), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, rho n x = 1) →
        ∀ (u v : ℕ → ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
          (∀ (n : ℕ), Summable fun j => ‖u n j‖ * ‖v n j‖) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
                HasSum (fun j => ⟪u n j, F⟫_ℂ • v n j) (A ((KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (rho n) ⋯ ⋯) F))) →
              ∀ (U W : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
                (Summable fun j => ‖U j‖ * ‖W j‖) →
                  (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
                      HasSum (fun j => ⟪U j, F⟫_ℂ • W j)
                        (((1 - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection).comp A) F)) →
                    have P := 1 - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection;
                    have M := fun n => KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (rho n) ⋯ ⋯;
                    (∀ (n : ℕ),
                        Filter.Tendsto
                          (fun T =>
                            Masullo.TraceClass.trace (A.comp (M n)) -
                              ∫ (x : X),
                                DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu e0 eF Theta T)
                                  (A.comp (M n)) x x ∂mu)
                          Filter.atTop (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((P.comp A).comp (M n))))) ∧
                      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((P.comp A).comp (M n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace (P.comp A))) :=
